title: 157 Million Switches Reach 2,200 Kilometers Up
description:
Stack every Switch ever sold. It reaches 2,200 kilometers up.

Sources:
- Nintendo IR: Dedicated Video Game Sales Units (as of September 30, 2026): https://www.nintendo.co.jp/ir/en/finance/hard_soft/index.html
- Wikipedia: Nintendo Switch: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nintendo_Switch
- Wikipedia: International Space Station: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/International_Space_Station
- Wikipedia: List of best-selling game consoles: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_best-selling_game_consoles

From Nintendo IR (as of September 30, 2026): 157.20 million Nintendo Switch units sold life-to-date. From Wikipedia (Nintendo Switch): the original console measures 173 x 102 x 14 mm. From Wikipedia (International Space Station): it orbits at 413-422 km. From Wikipedia (List of best-selling game consoles): the PlayStation 2 is the best-selling console with 160 million units; the Switch is second. Our math: 157.2 million x 14 mm = about 2,201 km; 157.2 million x 173 mm = about 27,196 km; 2,201 / 422 = 5.2; 160 - 157.2 = 2.8 million. Not financial advice.

first_comment: How many Switches would you stack to touch space? 👇

scenes.narration: Every Switch ever sold, stacked, reaches 2,200 kilometers up. But how can a game console get that tall?
That's over five times higher than the space station.

visual.stat_sub: the space station flies about 420 km up

scenes.narration: Because each one is only 14 millimeters thick.
Lay them end to end instead? 27,196 kilometers.
And it's still not number one. It's 2.8 million behind the PlayStation 2.
